name: skill-load
description: Discover and load agent skills — directories containing SKILL.md with frontmatter (name, description). Scans repo and user skill roots, parses metadata without a YAML dependency, and returns the full skill content plus its path so sibling resources stay reachable.
use_when: an agent needs to enumerate available skills or fetch a skill's instructions by name

args.name: list
args.description: Emit all discovered skills: {name, dir, path, root, description, metadata}.

args.name: get <name>
args.description: Emit one skill incl. full SKILL.md content; matches dir or frontmatter name.

args.name: --roots dir...
args.description: Override the default root scan list.

stdout: JSON skill list or single skill with 'content'.
notes: Read-only. First root wins on name collisions; default roots cover ./.devin, ./.claude, ./.agents, ~/.agents, ~/.claude, ~/.config/devin.
